name: Mũi thuyền lộng gió
notes: Into the wind at the bow of a little ship at sunset (KayKit Adventurers, CC0: the Barbarian without his bear hat and cape, his beard pulled into his face so he is clean-shaven, dark hair built in code, recoloured into a navy-and-white striped sailor shirt with a navy collar and belt, cream trousers and a red polka-dot kerchief; the Mage without her hat and cape, recoloured into a coral dress with a cream collar and a gold sash, bare calves and white shoes, a sky-blue bow in her hair; weapons and books dropped by scripts/pack-models.mjs). The rest is built in code: a sky page that folds up (golden hour, a dusk painted over it, a big sun that sinks behind the far sea), a sea of swells rolling past with foam at the bow, the ship (hull with portholes, deck, rail, a step at the bow, a mast with flag, lantern and bunting, a cabin with a wheel, a lifebuoy, an anchor), gulls, dolphins and wind streaks. Stop 1: she looks out from the bow rail while he steers; a gull lands on the wheel and he salutes it, tiptoes up behind her and ties his kerchief over her eyes; she jumps and laughs, he whispers at her side, and a gust spins the tag on the mast round to show the card's first words (slot note1). Stop 2: he leads her to the bow and lifts her onto the step; she pulls the kerchief off and spreads her arms into the wind, the kerchief streaming from her hand, his hands at her waist; dolphins leap alongside, and a page of the ship's log with the card's photo and caption (slot caption) blows in and is pegged to the mast. Stop 3: she lets the kerchief fly off to the sunset, steps down and turns to him; they kiss as the sun slips into the sea, the sky turns rose and violet, stars come out, the lantern lights, and two gulls fly in a banner with the last words (slot note2). The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in scenery.js, crew.js and story.js.
